intended_object: Absolute continuity of measures: μ ≪ ν iff every ν-null set is μ-null. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body ∀ s, ν s = 0 → μ s = 0 is the standard definition. It quantifies over all sets, not only measurable ones. This is equivalent to the textbook version because Mathlib measures are outer measures. If ν s = 0, the measurable superset toMeasurable ν s is also ν-null, so it is μ-null, and monotonicity gives μ s = 0. The setting (any measurable space, any two measures) is the natural one. Degenerate cases behave correctly: 0 ≪ ν for every ν, and μ ≪ μ.
